name: Disk Space Audit
description: Real disk-space report + safe auto-remediation: per-mount usage, top 10 largest files in noisy paths, total reclaimable bytes from old logs, and Docker overlay2 footprint. When any mount exceeds usePercentWarn or reclaimable old-log bytes exceed reclaimWarnGb, runs `journalctl --vacuum-time` and removes /tmp files older than logRetentionDays. Reports total bytes freed and creates a low-severity audit incident when cleanup actually ran.

inputs.name: usePercentWarn
inputs.description: Fail when any tracked mount exceeds this %use

inputs.name: reclaimWarnGb
inputs.description: Fail when reclaimable old logs exceed this many GB

steps.description: Per-mount %use, sorted desc. Filters pseudo filesystems so the output is meaningful.
steps.command: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 ${inputs.host} "df -hPl -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs -x squashfs -x overlay -x fuse.gvfsd-fuse 2>/dev/null | tail -n +2 | awk '{ printf \"%s=%s/%s(%s) \", \$6, \$3, \$2, \$5 } END { print \"\" }'"

steps.description: Fail (exit 2) when any tracked mount exceeds the warn threshold. Lists offending mounts.
steps.command: OFF=$(ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 ${inputs.host} "df -hPl -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs -x squashfs -x overlay -x fuse.gvfsd-fuse 2>/dev/null | awk -v t=${inputs.usePercentWarn} 'NR>1 { gsub(\"%\",\"\",\$5); if (\$5+0 > t) printf \"%s(%s%%) \", \$6, \$5 }'"); if [ -n "$OFF" ]; then echo "OVER_THRESHOLD: $OFF"; exit 2; else echo 'all mounts within threshold'; fi

steps.description: Top 10 largest files under noisy paths — the operator pastes this into the cleanup ticket. Uses -maxdepth 4 to keep the walk bounded on hosts with deep trees.
steps.command: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 ${inputs.host} 'find /var/log /tmp /var/cache -maxdepth 4 -type f -size +50M -printf "%s\t%p\n" 2>/dev/null | sort -rn | head -10 | awk "{ printf \"%.0fMB\\t%s\\n\", \$1/1024/1024, \$2 }" || true'

steps.description: Total bytes reclaimable from logs older than logRetentionDays. Fails when over threshold.
steps.command: BYTES=$(ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 ${inputs.host} "find /var/log -type f \( -name '*.log*' -o -name '*.gz' \) -mtime +${inputs.logRetentionDays} -printf '%s\n' 2>/dev/null | awk '{ s+=\$1 } END { print s+0 }'"); [ -z "$BYTES" ] && BYTES=0; GB=$(awk -v b="$BYTES" 'BEGIN { printf "%.2f", b/1024/1024/1024 }'); echo "reclaimable_old_logs_gb=$GB threshold_gb=${inputs.reclaimWarnGb} retention_days=${inputs.logRetentionDays}"; awk -v g="$GB" -v t="${inputs.reclaimWarnGb}" 'BEGIN { exit !(g > t) }' && { echo 'RECLAIM_EXCEEDED'; exit 3; } || true

steps.description: Docker storage footprint via df on the daemon's data root — fast (no tree walk) and aligned with how Docker itself sizes things
steps.command: DR=$(docker info --format '{{.DockerRootDir}}' 2>/dev/null || echo /var/lib/docker); ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 ${inputs.host} "df -h '$DR' 2>/dev/null | tail -1 | awk '{ printf \"docker_root=%s used=%s/%s(%s)\\n\", \$6, \$3, \$2, \$5 }'" || echo 'docker root not accessible'

steps.description: Decide whether remediation should run: ok=true (exit 0) when ANY of (mount over %, reclaimable over GB) breached.
steps.command: USAGE_OK='${steps.usage_check.ok}'; LOGS_OK='${steps.old_logs_reclaim.ok}'; echo "usage_ok=$USAGE_OK logs_ok=$LOGS_OK"; if [ "$USAGE_OK" = "false" ] || [ "$LOGS_OK" = "false" ]; then echo 'cleanup=needed'; exit 0; else echo 'cleanup=skip'; exit 1; fi

steps.description: Run cleanup only when needs_cleanup decided remediation is warranted.

REMEDIATION on ${inputs.host}: vacuum old journal logs to ${inputs.logRetentionDays}d and delete /tmp files older than ${inputs.logRetentionDays} days. Captures before/after disk usage on /. Idempotent (no-op when already clean).
steps.command: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=10 ${inputs.host} "BEFORE=\$(df -B1 / 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==2 {print \$3}'); [ -z \"\$BEFORE\" ] && BEFORE=0; JOUT=\$(journalctl --vacuum-time=${inputs.logRetentionDays}d 2>&1 | tail -5); TOUT=\$(find /tmp -type f -mtime +${inputs.logRetentionDays} -delete 2>/dev/null && echo tmp_cleaned || echo tmp_partial); AFTER=\$(df -B1 / 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==2 {print \$3}'); [ -z \"\$AFTER\" ] && AFTER=0; FREED=\$((BEFORE - AFTER)); FREED_MB=\$((FREED / 1024 / 1024)); echo \"REMEDIATION cleanup host=${inputs.host} retention_days=${inputs.logRetentionDays} root_used_before=\$BEFORE root_used_after=\$AFTER freed_bytes=\$FREED freed_mb=\$FREED_MB tmp=\$TOUT journal_vacuum=[\$JOUT]\""

steps.description: Decide whether to create an audit incident — only when cleanup actually ran successfully.
steps.command: CLEAN_OK='${steps.cleanup.ok}'; echo "cleanup.ok=$CLEAN_OK"; if [ "$CLEAN_OK" = "true" ]; then echo 'audit=needed'; exit 0; else echo 'audit=skip'; exit 1; fi

steps.description: Create audit incident only when cleanup ran.
AUDIT TRAIL: low-severity incident records that disk cleanup ran on the host.

params.title: Disk-space auto-remediation performed on ${inputs.host}
params.description: Disk-space-audit workflow auto-cleaned ${inputs.host}. Detection: usage_within_threshold=${steps.usage_check.ok} reclaim_within_threshold=${steps.old_logs_reclaim.ok}. Cleanup ok=${steps.cleanup.ok}. journalctl vacuum=${inputs.logRetentionDays}d, /tmp -mtime +${inputs.logRetentionDays} -delete. See workflow run record for freed bytes.

steps.description: Operator rollup. False ${steps.usage_check.ok} = mount over threshold; false ${steps.old_logs_reclaim.ok} = reclaimable exceeded. cleanup_ran=true means we acted on it.
steps.command: echo "DiskSpaceAudit on ${inputs.host}: usage_within_threshold=${steps.usage_check.ok} reclaim_within_threshold=${steps.old_logs_reclaim.ok} | remediation: cleanup_ran=${steps.cleanup.ok} audit_incident_created=${steps.create_audit_incident.ok}. If still over threshold, review steps.top_largest_files manually."
